title: overlay in overlay issue with infra-container
body:
### Issue Description

I am running podman exclusively rootless in a custom yocto build linux system with an overlay filesystem and running the podman system tests (/test/system). Most tests are running fine and some are expected to fail, but a big chunk relies on an infra-container, which should work. If I am configuring an infra_image in the containers.conf its working fine (infra_image="registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10"). The tests just failes, due to the leaked image and thats seems to be ok.

```bash
# # [teardown]
# vvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvv
# *** Leaked image: 873ed7510279 registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10
# setup(): removing stray image registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10
# setup(): removing stray image 873ed7510279
not ok 2 [200] pod exit policies - play kube
# tags: ci:parallel
# (from function `basic_teardown' in file test/system/helpers.bash, line 301,
#  from function `teardown' in test file test/system/200-pod.bats, line 14)
#   `basic_teardown' failed
#
# [10:50:51.446466997] $ /usr/bin/podman  play kube /tmp/podman_bats.6sqpqq/test.yaml
# [10:50:53.932521347] Pod:
# 5953c63a1f1387ccf901edc52eda273e2abc9cf42445f00085ff374f7621f3b2
# Container:
# abbc1bbb7fbca879976a7f1a2cea4b0ef34e7e3bd8b94ad213550156cd6fdec7
#
# [10:50:53.973751155] $ /usr/bin/podman  pod inspect p-t2-esqefzl5 --format {{.ExitPolicy}}
# [10:50:54.730520628] stop
#
# [10:50:54.786162749] $ /usr/bin/podman  pod inspect p-t2-esqefzl5 --format {{.State}}
# [10:50:55.004179691] Exited
#
# [10:50:55.048744259] $ /usr/bin/podman  pod rm p-t2-esqefzl5
# [10:50:55.429111684] 5953c63a1f1387ccf901edc52eda273e2abc9cf42445f00085ff374f7621f3b2
# # [teardown]
# vvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvv
# *** Leaked image: 873ed7510279 registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10
```
But the target systems do in general not have any internet access and I would like to use the default image and this does lead to the following issue I am not able to grap. Here just one example, There are about 50 Tests failing with the same issue:

```bash
$ bats  --filter podman ps --format PodName test/system/040-ps.bats
1..1
not ok 1 [040] podman ps --format PodName
# (from function `bail-now' in file test/system/helpers.bash, line 230,
#  from function `die' in file test/system/helpers.bash, line 997,
#  from function `run_podman' in file test/system/helpers.bash, line 608,
#  in test file test/system/040-ps.bats, line 245)
#   `run_podman run -d --pod new:${rand_value} --label mylabel=$rand_value $IMAGE sleep inf' failed
#
# [15:34:39.700001448] $ /usr/bin/podman  run -d --pod new:274ZapuVb9 --label mylabel=274ZapuVb9 quay.io/libpod/testimage:20241011 sleep inf
# [15:34:40.354493515] time="2026-10-22T15:34:40Z" level=error msg="Starting some container dependencies"
# time="2026-10-22T15:34:40Z" level=error msg="\"rootfs-overlay: creating overlay failed \\\"/run/user/1002/libpod/tmp/infra-container\\\" from native overlay: mount overlay:/opt/plcnext/.local/share/containers/storage/overlay-containers/d35c09933a8fdb7e62e5e741a28ec950e5d9306cbc2adc9a02f2e4f7b9829bb1/rootfs/merge, flags: 0x4, data: lowerdir=/run/user/1002/libpod/tmp/infra-container,upperdir=/opt/plcnext/.local/share/containers/storage/overlay-containers/d35c09933a8fdb7e62e5e741a28ec950e5d9306cbc2adc9a02f2e4f7b9829bb1/rootfs/upper,workdir=/opt/plcnext/.local/share/containers/storage/overlay-containers/d35c09933a8fdb7e62e5e741a28ec950e5d9306cbc2adc9a02f2e4f7b9829bb1/rootfs/work,userxattr: invalid argument\""
# Error: starting some containers: internal libpod error
# [15:34:40.368479744] [ rc=126 (** EXPECTED 0 **) ]
# #/vvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvv
# #| FAIL: exit code is 126; expected 0
# #\^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
# # [teardown]
```
For the overlay in overlay to function the following is configured in the storage.conf:

```bash
# Path to an helper program to use for mounting the file system instead of mounting it
# directly.
mount_program = "/usr/bin/fuse-overlayfs"

# mountopt specifies comma separated list of extra mount options
mountopt = "nodev"
```


### Steps to reproduce the issue

I am not able to explain how to reproduce it without having the OS running on an embedded device I have. But probably its just the overlay messing it up and it seems that the default infra-container does not take the mount_program option.

### Describe the results you received

Attached a merged log of all failing tests with a similar looking root cause:
[merged_logs.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33961107/merged_logs.txt)

### Describe the results you expected

I am not sure if the tests still are failing due to the leaked image when using the default infra_image. But no failed tests would, of course, be the best.

comments.body:
that happens because the infra image is built locally on a tmpfs, and that might cause the failure.

Can you try using `infra_image=pause`?

`infra_image=pause` is not accepted

```
Failed to obtain podman configuration: reading system config "/etc/containers/containers.conf": decode configuration /etc/containers/containers.conf: toml: line 74 (last key "engine.infra_image"): expected value but found "pause" instead
```
and `infra_image="pause"` expects a registry:
```
 bats  --filter podman pod create - custom volumes test/system/200-pod.bats
1..1
not ok 1 [200] podman pod create - custom volumes
# tags: ci:parallel
# (from function `bail-now' in file test/system/helpers.bash, line 230,

#  from function `run_podman' in file test/system/helpers.bash, line 608,
#  in test file test/system/200-pod.bats, line 85)
#   `CONTAINERS_CONF_OVERRIDE=$containersconf run_podman pod create' failed
#
# [14:13:49.773446442] $ /usr/bin/podman  pod create
# [14:13:49.984124900] Error: short-name "pause" did not resolve to an alias and no unqualified-search registries are defined in "/etc/containers/registries.conf"
# [14:13:49.998104238] [ rc=125 (** EXPECTED 0 **) ]
# #/vvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvv
# #| FAIL: exit code is 125; expected 0
# #\^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
```

as mentioned above, with `registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10.1` the tests do work but it they fail because of "Leaked image". I think its not a real issue.
But I am not able to put that image into the OS and internet connection isn't usually available.
